description: The busiest identities (up to 10) across the top, the index families they read down the side. Color runs teal (fewest events) to pink (most), on a log scale. A blank cell means few or no reads.

text.expr: length(data('rows')) ? length(domain('opacity')) + (length(domain('opacity')) == 1 ? ' identity' : ' identities') + ' × ' + length(domain('strokeWidth')) + (length(domain('strokeWidth')) == 1 ? ' index family' : ' index families') + ' shown' : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

url.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("indices:data/read/esql/search_shards", "indices:data/read/esql/data"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.domain, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | EVAL idx = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | EVAL idx = REPLACE(idx, """[-.]\d{8}[-.T]?\d{6}(?:[-.].*)?$""", "*") | EVAL idx = CASE(LEFT(idx, 1) == ".", CONCAT(REPLACE(idx, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*"), idx) | STATS events = SUM(n) BY actor, idx | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 500 | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…")

values.expr: !(length(data('rows'))) ? [] : floor(log(domain('color')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9) - ceil(log(domain('color')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9) >= 1 ? slice([1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000], ceil(log(domain('color')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9), 1 + floor(log(domain('color')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9)) : domain('color')[1] > domain('color')[0] ? domain('color') : [domain('color')[0]]
